title: 콕이네 집 #1 · 첫눈 오는 밤
logline: 첫눈 오는 밤, 급한 토끼는 이불을 열 번 털고 느린 늘보는 전기요 스위치 하나를 켠다.
product_prop: 전기요(전기장판) — 이야기 속 소품. 판정·안내 컷 없음(비교용)

cuts.scene: Night exterior seen through the bedroom window of a tiny handmade clay apartment: the first snow of winter falling in big soft clay flakes, warm yellow light inside.
poses: Snowflakes slightly lower, one flake landing on the window sill.
Snowflakes lower again, a thin layer of white clay snow on the sill.
cuts.flow: Gentle snowfall drifting down past the window, very slow camera push-in, cozy warm light flickers softly. Stop-motion claymation look.

cuts.scene: Inside the cozy clay bedroom at night. The wife rabbit stands on her small wooden step stool beside a low bed, flapping a big patchwork quilt in the air with both front paws.
poses: The quilt is lifted high above her head, her ears pointing straight up, mouth open mid-word.
The quilt snaps down onto the bed in a wave, her ears flopping forward, she leans in fast.
cuts.flow: The rabbit quickly flaps the quilt up and snaps it down twice, ears bouncing, fast and energetic. Stop-motion claymation, slightly choppy charming motion.

cuts.scene: The husband sloth stands in the bedroom doorway, holding a neatly folded electric blanket with its cord and small controller hanging down, calm sleepy face.
poses: His head has turned slightly toward the bed, eyes half closed.
He finishes one very slow blink, head turned a little further, tiny calm smile.
cuts.flow: The sloth turns his head extremely slowly and does one slow blink, nothing else moves. Calm, unhurried. Stop-motion claymation.

cuts.line: 베개 여기, 담요 저기, 양말은 어디 갔지?
cuts.scene: The wife rabbit darts around the bed: a pillow in one paw, a small blanket over her shoulder, looking around in a hurry.
poses: She is at the left side of the bed tossing the pillow into place, ears flying.
She is now at the right side, bending down to peek under the bed for socks, tail up.
cuts.flow: The rabbit dashes from one side of the bed to the other, tossing a pillow, then ducks to look under the bed. Fast, busy, comedic. Stop-motion claymation.

cuts.line: 아 손 시려! 보일러 몇 도야?
cuts.scene: Close shot of the wife rabbit rubbing her front paws together quickly, little clay puffs of breath, looking toward a wall thermostat.
poses: Paws pressed together near her mouth, blowing on them.
She points at the thermostat with one paw, ears twitching, eyebrows up.
cuts.flow: The rabbit rubs her paws together fast, blows on them, then points at the wall thermostat. Quick snappy motion. Stop-motion claymation.

cuts.scene: The husband sloth slowly kneels at the foot of the bed, spreading the electric blanket flat under the sheet with his long arms.
poses: His long arms have smoothed the electric blanket halfway across the mattress.
The electric blanket lies flat and neat, he slowly reaches for the small controller.
cuts.flow: The sloth very slowly smooths the electric blanket across the mattress with his long arms, then slowly reaches for the controller. Calm, slow. Stop-motion claymation.

cuts.line: 다 깔았다! 근데 왜 아직도 차갑지?
cuts.scene: The wife rabbit has jumped into the bed under the quilt, only her head and long ears out, shivering, teeth chattering.
poses: She pulls the quilt up to her nose, ears trembling.
She wiggles deeper under the quilt, only her eyes and ears visible, shivering.
cuts.flow: The rabbit shivers under the quilt, pulling it up to her nose, ears trembling fast. Stop-motion claymation.

cuts.scene: Close-up: the husband sloth's long clawed finger slowly approaching the switch of a small electric blanket controller on the bedside.
poses: His claw is touching the switch.
The switch is on and a small warm orange light glows on the controller.
cuts.flow: Close-up of a long sloth claw slowly pressing a switch, a small orange light turns on and glows warmly. Very slow. Stop-motion claymation.

cuts.line: 어? 등이 따끈해… 언제 켠 거야?
cuts.scene: The wife rabbit in bed, her shivering stopped, eyes going wide with surprise, then melting into a cozy relaxed face.
poses: Her eyes are wide with surprise, ears perked up.
Her eyes half close in bliss, ears relaxed and drooping, cozy smile.
cuts.flow: The rabbit stops shivering, eyes widen in surprise, then she melts into a cozy relaxed smile, ears drooping. Stop-motion claymation.

cuts.scene: The husband sloth stands at the bedside and slowly pulls the quilt up over the rabbit's shoulders.
poses: The quilt is halfway up, his long arms moving slowly.
The quilt is tucked neatly at her shoulders, he gives a tiny calm nod.
cuts.flow: The sloth very slowly pulls the quilt up and tucks it around the rabbit, then a tiny slow nod. Gentle and slow. Stop-motion claymation.

cuts.scene: The wife rabbit sits up in bed grinning and raises one front paw high, waiting for a high-five. The sloth beside the bed looks at her paw.
poses: Her paw is raised high, she bounces slightly, grinning.
She is still holding the paw up, wiggling it impatiently, the sloth starts lifting his arm very slowly.
cuts.flow: The rabbit raises her paw for a high-five and wiggles it impatiently while the sloth begins to lift his arm extremely slowly. Comedic timing. Stop-motion claymation.

cuts.scene: The slow high-five: the sloth's long arm slowly reaching the rabbit's raised paw beside the bed, snow visible through the window.
poses: The sloth's paw is a few centimeters from the rabbit's paw, she is laughing.
Their paws meet in a soft high-five, both smiling, snow falling outside the window.
cuts.flow: The sloth's arm slowly arrives and the two paws meet in a soft high-five, both smile, snow falls outside. Stop-motion claymation, warm ending.
